I am on LUXURY_TAX with $1061 cash and three unmortgaged properties. I cannot build or trade for monopolies yet. I will end my turn.

All three orange properties are now owned by different players. The yellows, greens, browns, and pinks are split among the players.

Player 2 controls the dark blue monopoly with two houses on each property. Their cash is only $167, so they cannot build further. Player 1 has many properties but no monopoly.

Player 3 has $783 and no monopoly. I will keep my cash liquid and avoid mortgaging my properties. Completing the orange set would require two trades, which is unlikely to succeed.

I considered trading with player 1 for Pennsylvania to complete the green set, but that would give them two-thirds of the orange set. Player 1 is also close to completing light blue and pink sets. I will not propose a trade right now.

I weighed trading New York for St. James from player 1. That would leave me needing only Tennessee to complete the orange set, but the trade is overpaying since New York is worth more than St. James. Player 3 rejected cash offers before, and his scattered holdings make him a poor target.

Player 1 would likely reject a trade for New York in exchange for St. James, since they need that property to complete their orange set and New York does not help them finish their green set. Player 3 would also reject it, as New York does not complete his holdings. I am now considering whether to buy player 2's mortgaged reds or acquire a get-out-of-jail-free card.
